Method

How the numbers are calculated.

Levels 1–10 use captured game metadata. Levels 11–301 apply FoE Helper’s 2.5% exponential FP rule. Levels after 10 require another full blueprint set; six newer Great Buildings also require scaling goods and other resources. Contributor FP reproduces its era table and recursive rounding for P2–P5. Medal and blueprint tables are unboosted source values checked against live game construction responses through level 201. Levels 202–301 use separately fitted FP, medal, and blueprint curves, and the dashboard labels those results as modeled before applying the same FoE Helper Arc rounding.
